# Market Diary / 牛牛市场雷达

Purpose: evidence-first financial content operations workbench for Hong Kong and US market coverage.

This is NOT a trading journal and NOT an investment/trading tool.

Core questions: What should be produced first today? Why does it matter? What can be written directly? What evidence supports it? What still needs verification?

Workflow: source collection -> initial screening -> deduplication -> AI-assisted structuring -> human verification against primary sources -> editorial decision -> dashboard.

Human verification is mandatory for key numbers, dates, and wording. AI is not treated as a factual source.

Main views:
- 今日 / Today: one current verified priority plus a clearly dated recent shortlist.
- 问一下 / Ask: natural-language lookup and structured quick read, deep read, or event comparison.
- 市场 / Market: event overview, next checkpoints, evidence-separated search, and metadata comparison; it is not a realtime quote terminal.
- 我的 / My: local-only watchlist, saved drafts, dataset freshness, candidate-processing mode, and source health.

Stable routes: #radar, #workbench, #market, #my, and shareable #event/<id>. Legacy #daily, #library, #content, and #watchlist routes remain compatible.

Data boundaries:
- data/events.json: verified editorial events eligible for structured output.
- data/candidates.json and data/ai-candidates.json: unverified leads; they may only produce verification checklists.
- Free-text key numbers are display-only and must not be ranked or treated as comparable metrics.
- User watchlists and drafts stay in the local browser.
- Usage analytics are off by default. Only explicit consent creates a random browser ID and sends allowlisted page/action events. Questions, searches, watchlists, drafts, clipboard contents, full URLs, IP addresses, full user agents, and precise location are not included. Records are retained for at most 90 days and the visitor can stop/reset the ID.
- The owner dashboard reports consented anonymous browser IDs, not all real people. Optional invite links use opaque random codes mapped to private owner notes.
- verified=true is currently an editorial state; verifiedAt and verifiedBy are not yet structured audit fields.

Correction case: SHEIN. The system initially confused the Aug 28 trading-arrangement announcement date with the listing/trading date. Human verification returned to HKEX and corrected the planned trading date to Sep 1, 2026.

Canonical site: https://devi-y.github.io/market-diary/
AI-readable review: https://github.com/Devi-Y/Devi-Y.github.io/blob/main/market-diary/AI_REVIEW.md
